candidates.statement: Inventory is rejecting configuration values (configuration_valid=false, cfg-017), producing 14 configuration rejections, 7 ERROR log occurrences with status 503, and a 10% error rate; gateway's call to inventory errors at 917ms and inventory's checkout span errors at 1350ms, degrading checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone does not establish causation; no inventory config diff or rejection detail beyond counts.

report.explanation: Inventory shows invalid configuration (cfg-017) with configuration rejections, ERROR logs returning 503, and elevated error rate, matching the errored gateway->inventory call and inventory checkout span. Order and gateway metrics/logs remain healthy, so the bounded root cause is inventory bad configuration.
